hypothesis.claim: At least one of the five predeclared tensor groups recovers a positive portion of the held even7 model's 1207-byte public-fixture archive penalty when restored independently to its original signed values. The matched table will quantify archive recovery, probability divergence, whole-process costs and restored model/package components without selecting a successor.
hypothesis.falsification: With valid implementation and closure evidence, nonpositive archive recovery for every individual group refutes this directional hypothesis on the examined fixture. Failed exact parameter, anchor, coder, raw inverse or replay checks invalidate the affected implementation evidence; missing resource evidence or exhausted budgets are separate outcomes. No fixture result proves full-corpus economics or additive interactions.

changedMechanism: Starting from the exact held even7 Q model, separately restore the original INT4 values of each fixed group E, A, R, U or V. Each treatment starts from the same Q; restorations are never cumulative. P restores all original weights, Q preserves even7, and K preserves Q with histogram bookkeeping. All tensor metadata, scales, non-INT4 bits, FX2TFWC2 coding, cached native predictor, frontend and arithmetic coder remain bound.
invariants: ROOT owns lifecycle, proposal, candidate, queue, admission and execution. This contract alone grants no launch authority. Preserve HORIZON, MIDAS and other owners; install and train nothing.

Exactly 43 phases are prescribed: one mutator compile, one synthetic self-test, sixteen model-generation calls (eight arms and one independent repeat each), one fixture preprocess and twenty-four native codec processes (encode, separate decode and fresh reencode for each arm). No native binary compilation, training or model installation occurs.

Freeze eight arms in order P,Q,K,E,A,R,U,V and five nonoverlapping groups covering exactly 111 INT4 tensors and 5868864 events. E is embedding.weight.q, prior_embedding.weight.q and unembedding.weight.q (3 tensors). A is query/key/value/output attention projection weights in blocks 3,7,11 (12 tensors). R is those four attention weights plus forget/output gate up/down weights in the other nine blocks (72 tensors). U and V are respectively mlp.up.weight.q and mlp.down.weight.q in blocks 0 through 11 (12 tensors each). Unknown names or noncanonical block indices reject.

Each restoration starts from the exact 2066802-byte even7 D artifact, renamed Q here. The fixed map remains [-6,-6,-4,-4,-4,-2,0,0,0,2,4,4,4,6,6] for original signed values -7 through 7. Restored group events take their exact original values; all other events retain Q. Original and Q differ in 3119371 INT4 events. No post-result tensor selection, clipping, scaling, combined groups or map changes are allowed.

Fresh synthetic self-test must cover all eight arms, five groups, all fifteen signed values per group, six exceptional raw bit patterns and four unknown-group rejections. Each real-model output and independent repeat must pass direct parameter comparison, canonical output regeneration, unchanged non-INT4 bits and exact expected restoration counts. A matching size or digest alone cannot replace direct comparison.

P output must equal the original 2930652-byte model; Q and K outputs must equal the retained 2066802-byte even7 model. E/A/R/U/V remain partial restorations of a lossy weight transformation, never claimed to invert the original model. Every native arm must nevertheless reconstruct the exact raw fixture.

Probability diagnostics verify stored truth and every arithmetic interval transition, record the first probability difference and changed probability-record counts against P and Q, and sum effective interval loss by chronological thirds. Binary64 log2/fsum values are diagnostics, not exact archive bytes or a proof of causal additivity.

Report archive recovery for each arm as 4430 minus measured archive bytes, original-parent archive delta as measured archive bytes minus 3223, and independently measured whole-phase elapsed/user/system CPU where available. Native costs include initialization and trace I/O; kernel-only CPU remains null with explicit missing diagnostics.

Separately report original-model and Q-relative components. These components are not a materialized complete submission package.

Expected transfer retention 0, runtime/memory ratios 1 and uncertainty/interaction risks 1 are declared planning placeholders, not measured forecasts. Diagnose all five groups regardless of observed economics, subject to the frozen safety/elapsed caps. Publish the complete restoration table; do not rank-select a mixed-precision successor, sum independent recoveries, authorize a larger launch or use a cold-fixture extrapolation as mathematical futility. Successful infrastructure and a closed valid diagnostic reflection permit considering the measured evidence for a future proposal. Promotion remains blocked by missing dependency/license closure, isolated calibrated resource qualification and full billion-byte reconstruction. Full-corpus score remains null, complete package remains unknown and objective credit is zero against the active 99000000-byte objective.

Close all child processes, revalidate source/cache identities, record and remove only the owned PPM transient after verified closure, publish mandatory artifact fingerprints, then require canonical outer guard/job closure and a validated reflection. Missing mandatory evidence blocks a valid result. Optional CPU or kernel-only telemetry remains explicitly missing and cannot fabricate a codec failure or qualification proof.
